content.text: Let me run a final end-to-end batch test through the actual process:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && timeout 175 python3 - << 'EOF'
import sys, json, random, subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import ref, fuzz, fuzz2, fuzz3, fuzz4, fuzz5

gens = [fuzz.gen_request, fuzz2.gen_medium, fuzz3.gen, fuzz4.gen, fuzz5.gen]
rng = random.Random(31337)
requests = []
for i in range(240):
    g = gens[i % len(gens)]
    req = g(rng) if g is not fuzz2.gen_medium else fuzz2.gen_medium(rng)
    requests.append(req)

# feed in batches of 8 lines
mismatch = 0
lines_out = 0
for start in range(0, len(requests), 8):
    batch = requests[start:start+8]
    payload = ('\n'.join(json.dumps(r) for r in batch) + '\n').encode()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                       input=payload, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr[:400]
    out = p.stdout.decode()
    assert p.stderr == b'', p.stderr[:200]
    lines = out.split('\n')
    assert lines[-1] == ''
    lines = lines[:-1]
    assert len(lines) == len(batch), (len(lines), len(batch))
    for req, line in zip(batch, lines):
        lines_out += 1
        expected = ref.compile_reference(req)
        got = json.loads(line)
        if expected == 'E_COMPLEXITY':
            if got != {'ok': False, 'error': 'E_COMPLEXITY'}:
                print('COMPLEXITY MISMATCH'); mismatch += 1
            continue
        if got != expected:
            mismatch += 1
            print('MISMATCH:', json.dumps(req)[:400])
            print(' got:', json.dumps(got)[:300])
            print(' exp:', json.dumps(expected)[:300])
            break
    if mismatch:
        break
print('end-to-end: %d request lines, %d mismatches' % (lines_out, mismatch))
EOF
